title: Make route height rail editable
summary: Make the Settings route height range rail directly editable with draggable boundary handles and inline height inputs.
reason: Operators should be able to adjust the visual route bucket boundaries from the colored rail instead of hunting for derived tolerance controls below the cards.
behavior_before: The colored route range rail displayed derived bucket ranges but was read-only; height boundary edits required changing tolerance controls lower in the bucket cards.
behavior_after: The colored route range rail exposes editable height inputs for the 1080p upper boundary and 4K lower boundary and supports dragging either boundary to update existing tolerance controls.
manual_validation: PYTHONPATH=src apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe -m unittest tests.webview.test_webview_css_design_tokens tests.webview.test_webview_handbrake_settings_ui -q -> passed; 38 tests OK.

Browser-backed Settings route rail final interaction check via the repository CDP harness -> passed; full 1200/1800 values fit in the colored inputs, typing 1188 updated the 1080p hidden boundary/range/payload, and dragging the 4K segment moved the 4K lower boundary to 1695 with synchronized range text and payload.

Browser-backed Settings route rail visual check via the repository CDP harness -> passed; 3 rail segments, control values 1200 and 1800, viewportOverflow=0, railOverflow=0, overlaps=[]. Screenshot captured at <temp>\mediapipeline-settings-route-rail-editable.png.
PYTHONPATH=src powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ops/scripts/smoke/Test-WebViewSettingsLaunchPolicySmoke.ps1 -> passed; 1 test OK.

Final strict coverage rerun -> failed due unrelated ops/release/changes/unreleased/MP-CHANGE-2026-0605-010.json missing required field date_completed and not being listed in files_touched of any unreleased packet. This packet's files were not listed as uncovered.
rollback_plan: Revert the Settings partial, Settings page CSS, Settings patch-review JavaScript, focused WebView tests, and generated summaries for the editable route range rail.
notes:
Presentation/control-surface change only. Dragging and typing update existing WebView builder controls; backend Preview/Save remains authoritative. No media policy, queue, pending-publish, rename, filesystem mutation, or media processing behavior is changed.
Added editable route height rail inputs and draggable boundary interactions wired to existing builder controls.
Refreshed generated summaries for the editable route height rail.
